name: Ty’r Graig Castle
niche_feature: Whole building is a 1892 Victorian gothic castle-shaped family house (not medieval); 11 en-suite rooms including Premium, Four Poster and Standard Turret rooms plus two hillside rooms.
evidence_quote: It resembles both a castle - in fact he oftened referred to it as his 'beloved castle'
reason: Purpose-built 1892 castellated gothic house with turret rooms, sold as castle hotel; borderline since not medieval, so kept.
page_issues: Castle is a Victorian (1892) gothic-style house resembling a castle, not a medieval fortress; official site itself says both 'completed in 1892' and 'late 1890s'
Official rooms page lists two hillside rooms separately from the turret rooms; page does not mention turret room types
Booking page widget on official site dated 2025; current trading status not independently confirmed

name: Walworth Castle Hotel
niche_feature: Castle rooms, four-poster suites (some in the towers) and the King James I Suite are inside the main castle; annex rooms are in an adjoining modern building, plus a gatehouse Lodge (6 guests) and a holiday cottage.
evidence_quote: Castle rooms have either twin or double beds and are located within the main castle.
reason: Real castle with guest rooms in the castle itself, but annex rooms, gatehouse lodge and cottage are separate, ordinary buildings.
page_issues: Page does not mention that the annex rooms, Walworth Castle Lodge (gatehouse) and Holiday Cottage are outside the main castle
Grade I listing, 12th-century origins and c.1600 completion not stated on the official pages checked

name: YHA St Briavels Castle
niche_feature: Hostel occupies the whole 800-year-old Norman castle (main building plus East Tower); eight dormitory/family bedrooms. Beds are bunk-style in shared rooms; hostel not hotel.
evidence_quote: this 800-year-old Norman Castle is packed with history and boasts remarkably well-preserved original features
reason: Guests sleep inside a genuine Norman castle; official YHA access statement confirms. Hostel format only.
page_issues: YHA access statement (Sept 2025) lists three East Tower bedrooms (6, 8 and 10 beds), not two
Room capacities in the access statement run from 5 to 14 and total about 64 beds, not 'three to twelve' / 'up to 50'
Main YHA page returned 403 (bot wall); evidence taken from the official YHA access-statement PDF

name: Adelya Cave Hotel
niche_feature: Nine rooms in a restored family house; the Woodshed, Grandpa Mehmet & Grandma Havva's Room, Stable and Hayloft are described as carved into rock, the Wine House as a cave room; Stone Room and Çardak are not described as cave.
evidence_quote: Carved into the rock, this room once served as the family's stable.
reason: Several rooms are explicitly rock-carved, but not all nine; mixed house of cave and built rooms.
page_issues: Page says to 'ask which rooms are rock-cut'; official room pages state Woodshed, Grandpa Mehmet room, Stable and Hayloft are carved into rock, Wine House is a cave room
Page highlight 'Heart of Göreme' is the hotel's own wording

name: Benesse House Naoshima
niche_feature: Museum-hotel (opened 1992) with guest rooms among contemporary art, in four buildings (Museum, Oval, Park, Beach). Nothing states rooms are cave, rock-cut or underground.
evidence_quote: Benesse House is both a museum and a hotel, incorporating guest rooms and space for display of contemporary art.
reason: Concrete art-museum hotel by Ando; not carved into rock or in a cave, and fits none of the 14 categories. Closest category chosen by editor: hillside-by-the-sea site, nothing fits exactly.
page_issues: Category cave-hotels is wrong: it is a concrete museum hotel
Official site lists building names Museum, Oval, Park, Beach; claims of specific artists, 8pm museum access and monorail not checked
Rating 9.3 and 427 reviews unverified; official site announces maintenance closures (Jan-Mar 2027)

name: Cappadocia Cave Suites
niche_feature: Hotel of cave suites in Göreme; official site says its cave rooms are carved into rock formations. Third-party showcaves.com lists 34 rooms in former Hittite/Roman/Byzantine houses and caves.
evidence_quote: Carved into ancient rock formations, our luxury cave rooms provide an unforgettable stay where tradition meets modern elegance.
reason: Official site presents the hotel's rooms as carved cave rooms in Göreme; per-room cave status not itemised.
page_issues: 'Daily hot air balloon flights from the property' unsupported; official site offers a balloon ride booking as an activity
Stone hammam 'carved from the tufa below the hotel' and 18°C tufa temperature not on the official page checked
Rating 9.1 / 1,876 reviews and '60 to 80 balloons' unverified
Official site says only 'cave suites/rooms'; some room types (Standard, Queen with balcony) not confirmed as rock-cut

name: Cappadocia Inans Cave Suites
niche_feature: Ten rooms (101-104, 201-203, 302, 401, 402), each labelled a 'Special Cave Room' / cave suite, plus a heated cave pool; the site does not describe carving in detail.
evidence_quote: INANS CAVE SUITE Special Cave Rooms
reason: Official room pages label all ten rooms as cave rooms/suites, though carved construction is not spelled out.
page_issues: Official address is in Nar village (Çavuş Sokak No:8, 50130 Nar), not central Nevşehir
Official site never states rooms are rock-carved, only 'cave rooms'; cave pool described as heated 'Cave Pool' without detail

name: Charming Cave Cappadocia Hotel
niche_feature: Fifteen rooms: five Standard Cave Rooms (301-305) in the courtyard plus a Cave Suite (103) are cave rooms; Standard and Deluxe Stone Rooms, Junior Suites and others are built-stone or other rooms.
evidence_quote: Charming Cave Hotel is totaly unique caved from the natural rocks and stones of Cappadocia
reason: Cave rooms confirmed for some units only; rest are stone-built or standard rooms.
page_issues: Page does not state that only about six of fifteen rooms (five Standard Cave Rooms plus Cave Suite) are cave rooms
Official site wording about rock carving is general, not per room

name: Cuevas La Granja
niche_feature: Complex of 18 cave houses (studios, 1-3 bedroom units) in Benalúa, Guadix region, on a 25,000 m2 estate with pool open June-September.
evidence_quote: Nuestro complejo de 18 casas cueva, ubicado en Benalúa, te ofrece una experiencia única
reason: Official site states the complex consists of 18 cave houses; every bookable unit is a cave house.

name: Desert Cave Hotel
niche_feature: First underground hotel in Coober Pedy (opened 1988); has dugout underground rooms and also ordinary above-ground rooms. Official site only describes Coober Pedy's underground hotels in general, not which rooms here.
evidence_quote: There are also rooms above ground for visitor who do not like to be underground.
reason: Underground dugout rooms confirmed by a third-party cave guide; hotel also has above-ground rooms, so only some rooms qualify.
page_issues: Page implies all rooms are underground; source says there are also above-ground rooms
'Indoor underground swimming pool', constant 23°C, 70% of world's opals and 'opals visible in room walls' not confirmed by checked sources
Official site does not itemise underground vs above-ground room counts; room count figures conflict across sources
Booking.com rating 8.2 / 634 reviews unverified

name: Gamirasu Cave Hotel
niche_feature: Hotel set within a restored Byzantine monastic retreat in Ayvalı village with 35 individually designed cave rooms and suites; 12th-century Ayvalı Church within the grounds.
evidence_quote: Set within a restored Byzantine monastic retreat, the hotel features 35 individually designed cave rooms and suites
reason: Official site states 35 cave rooms and suites in a restored Byzantine monastic complex.
page_issues: '6th-century' and 'functioning monastery for over 1,000 years' not stated on official site (it mentions a 12th-century church in the grounds)
'Thirty minutes from Göreme' and 'balloon launches from fields immediately below' not on the official pages checked; site says Ayvalı is 10 km from Ürgüp
Page says 'original Byzantine frescoes visible in some room niches': not stated; frescoes are in the church/valley
Rating 9.1 / 743 reviews unverified

name: Georgios Cave Cappadocia
niche_feature: Registered Rum (Greek) mansion in traditional stone architecture with nine 'stone/rock rooms'; only Room 105 is named 'Premium Cave Suit'. Official pages do not say rooms are carved into rock.
evidence_quote: Konforlu ve otantik dekorasyona sahip taş/kaya odalar
reason: Official site calls rooms stone/rock rooms in a historic mansion; cave or rock-cut rooms not confirmed.
page_issues: 'Cave' appears only in the name and in room 105 'Premium Cave Suit'; no checked source confirms any room is rock-cut
